description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing transfer-related state, including fetching transfer data and adding new transfers, utilizing external API functions and action types.

methods.name: fetchTransfers
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that fetches transfer data and updates the Redux store accordingly.

methods.name: fetchTransfersStatus
methods.description: Action creator that dispatches the status of transfer fetching process.

methods.name: addTransfer
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that creates a new transfer and updates the store.
